_design_note: M4 anchor plus a behaviour-cloned warm start. Two factors change together on purpose: the initial weights, and the exploration start (E07 1.00 -> E08 0.20). They are coupled -- holding epsilon at 1.00 over a cloned policy spends the clone before it can be used -- so this arm is declared as a two-factor increment rather than pretending to be one. docs/05 section 8.6 records the known bias: rule_based_agent never emits WAIT on loot-crate, so the clone never waits. The handcrafted line's standing failure is the opposite one (WAIT ranked above a visible escape, docs/05 section 0.13), so wait_fraction and the 'saw the exit and waited' diagnostic count are the numbers to read here, not score.

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: initial_model (none -> behaviour cloning) together with exploration_version (E07 -> E08).
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: The M4 anchor arm at the same budget.
_predeclared_design_numbers.demonstrations: pretraining/demonstrations/rule_based_agent_loot-crate_v2_150000.npz, sha256 dbf1d002cb5865c36600423ec4f624d9a9412045bf6d2fbea7ce3ed6209eb685: 150000 states from rule_based_agent over 477 loot-crate rounds. Action counts UP 34282 / RIGHT 34607 / DOWN 34261 / LEFT 34372 / WAIT 0 / BOMB 12478. Cloned for 3 epochs to 0.897 validation accuracy against a 0.231 majority class.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: If the final score is indistinguishable from the anchor's and the early checkpoints are not clearly higher, the warm start bought nothing and should not be carried into the final agent.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: The early checkpoints rise faster than the anchor's. No prediction is made about the final score.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: Report all five training-seed distributions, every G2 threshold, and coins_share alongside score for every arm that has opponents.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_loot_crate: docs/01 section 7.21: the five-seed spread of the handcrafted control gives sd 3.77, so two arms measured once each need a gap of 4.7 before a direction may be read into it.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: docs/01 section 7.20: pooled 450-round classic-with-opponents score has sd 0.089, so two arms need a gap of 0.246 (coins_share: 0.022).
